visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a medium shot of an elderly man in a white tank top working in a traditional kitchen. He is lifting a large stainless steel container. The background features several industrial-sized refrigerators and yellow and red signs in Traditional Chinese. Lighting is bright and even. (2) A close-up shows hands using a flat metal scoop to gently place smooth, white tofu pudding into a white ceramic bowl. The movement is precise and fluid. (3) The scene shifts to an outdoor perspective showing the storefront of a traditional shop named '余足古早味豆花'. A few people are seen in the distance, and the street is narrow with buildings close together. (4) Multiple close-ups focus on the prepared dessert bowls. One bowl is filled with white liquid and topped with a generous amount of black sesame powder, surrounded by colorful taro and sweet potato balls. A spoon lifts a piece of tofu pudding, showing its soft, jiggly texture. (5) Another bowl is shown containing brown sugar syrup, peanuts, and ice shavings. The peanuts look soft and well-cooked. (6) The final shot shows the street view again, with scooters parked along the side and the shop's blue and white signs clearly visible under natural daylight.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 高雄這家. (2) [Subtitle]: 古早味豆花店. (3) [Subtitle]: 已經開了20多年. (4) [Subtitle]: 豆花是每天自家製作的. (5) [Subtitle]: 很多客人都會一次外帶好幾碗. (6) [Subtitle]: 我們也很喜歡來買. (7) [Subtitle]: 可以加糖水、豆漿或牛奶. (8) [Subtitle]: 這碗是鮮奶豆花. (9) [Subtitle]: 加上黑芝麻粉. (10) [Subtitle]: 香氣濃郁. (11) [Subtitle]: 口感綿密滑嫩. (12) [Subtitle]: 我們點了很多配料. (13) [Subtitle]: 一定要試試手工芝麻圓. (14) [Subtitle]: 還有芋圓地瓜圓. (15) [Subtitle]: 搭配軟Q的小湯圓超滿足. (16) [Subtitle]: 如果想吃清爽一點. (17) [Subtitle]: 可以選原味豆花. (18) [Subtitle]: 加手炒糖水. (19) [Subtitle]: 甜而不膩. (20) [Subtitle]: 很適合來一份軟綿的花生享用. (21) [Subtitle]: 也可以加點碎冰更冰涼. (22) [Subtitle]: 喜歡豆花的快去試試. (23) [Subtitle]: 余足古早味豆花 高雄市左營區西陵街140號. (24) [Subtitle]: 我們是虎麗笑嗨嗨 下次再一起吃美食囉.
